pergunta: How did Audrey calm down her dog after the leash incident?
ouro: Petted, hugged, spoke calmly and slowly walked the dog

Session date: 7:49 pm on 6 September, 2023
[D18:9] Andrew: That's so heartwarming! Seeing them enjoy themselves like that is always a joy. :)
[D18:10] Audrey: I'm so happy seeing them have a great time. Last week I even got some new beds for them, just to give them some extra comfort now the weather's cooling down and they were happy! It's incredible how such a simple thing can bring them so much happiness.
[D18:11] Andrew: Animals can really find joy in the simple things. That was so nice of you. Do you have any pictures of the new beds?
[...]
[D18:17] Andrew: Yeah, I've been wanting to for a while, but it's a bit difficult since Toby is still so young.
[D18:18] Audrey: Did you find a dog-friendly place to live yet? I remember you mentioning it.
[D18:19] Andrew: Nah, still working on that. It's been a bit challenging.
[D18:20] Audrey: Keep going, you'll find a great place to live for your pet soon!
[D18:21] Andrew: Thanks! I appreciate the help. I'll keep searching for that perfect place for dogs!
[D18:22] Audrey: No worries! You got this. Don't give up. Take care!
Session date: 5:53 pm on 24 September, 2023
[D19:1] Andrew: Hey Audrey! Long time no talk! How have you been?
[D19:2] Audrey: Hey! I'm alright. Had some bumps though - last Friday at the park one of my pups saw something and pulled so hard the leash busted. Scared that she might run off and get hurt, so I had to chase after her. Luckily I caught her before anything bad happened. Little moments like this remind me how important she is and how we should be careful when we're out there.
[D19:3] Andrew: Oh man, sorry to hear that! I'm totally getting anxious just thinking about my dog getting lost. Precious must have been really scared. What did you do to calm her down?

Session date: 9:02 am on 22 November, 2023
[D28:1] Audrey: Hey Andrew! Long time no talk! Last Friday I took my fur kids to the pet salon - they were so psyched and their tails were wagging like crazy! It took a while for them to calm down, but all cut up they looked so cute! 
[D28:2] Andrew: Hey Audrey! Nice to hear from you. Sounds adorable! Do you have any pictures of them all groomed up?
[D28:3] Audrey: Here's a pic of them, looking all groomed. Look at those shiny coats! To top it off, they were really good at the salon - I always worry about them in new places.
[D28:4] Andrew: Wow, they look great! Love seeing them happy and calm in new places.
[D28:5] Audrey: Thanks! It means a lot to see them happy and settled in new places. I guess I'm doing a good job as a doggy mom then, haha! Have you taken your furry friends to the groomers yet?
[D28:6] Andrew: No, we haven't got the chance to take them to the groomer yet. But will do that soon! So guess what, I can't help myself but to adpot another dog the other day. Here's a photo of the doggo!
[D28:7] Audrey: That's great news! What's the pups name?
[...]
[D28:11] Audrey: Sounds like a great start for Scout! Start small, and gradually give them more exposure. They'll have a great time, just make sure to keep them leashed.
[D28:12] Andrew: Yeah, safety first! For now, we're keeping the new addition on a leash while they get used to being outside. That pic you of your dog at the park is so cute. So we got some essentials for their comfort and entertainment, like a bed, toys, and some puppy pads just in case. It's like their own little safe haven.
[D28:13] Audrey: Wow, that's so great that you two are creating a safe and fun space for Scout. It's really important they have a place that makes them feel secure. Slowly introduce Scout to Toby and Buddy, it takes time for the pups to get used to each other too! Scout is so lucky to have you and your girlfriend! 
[...]
[D28:16] Andrew: That's great to hear! Dogs truly bring so much joy and friendship. I'm glad they're happy with you.
[D28:17] Audrey: Thanks! They're really awesome and bring so much joy and friendship. I'm so grateful to have them in my life as a part of my family.
[D28:18] Andrew: Yeah, it's great! Dogs are always there for us. We should count ourselves lucky to have such amazing furry friends as family member.

Session date: 5:53 pm on 24 September, 2023

Session date: 7:09 pm on 1 October, 2023
[D20:5] Andrew: Aww, they look so cute! That spot looks ideal for them to play. Where did you take them?
[D20:6] Audrey: We took them to the dog park nearby last Saturday. There was a big grassy area for them to play and lots of shaded spots for me to relax. They had a great time!
[D20:7] Andrew: Sounds great! Missing that experience. Can't wait for the coming up hike!
[...]
[D20:11] Andrew: I've seen them up close and it's amazing how they fly with grace and freedom.
[D20:12] Audrey: Yeah, birds are really amazing! I love how they can fly around and explore. They have a freedom that I wish I had!
[D20:13] Andrew: Agreed! Watching them fly is so freeing and awe-inspiring. It's a great reminder to appreciate nature.
[D20:14] Audrey: Yeah, for sure. It's a great way to appreciate nature. That reminds me that I've been wanting to do some birdwatching. It's really peaceful and calming.
[D20:15] Andrew: Yeah do that! It's really peaceful and calming. It's nice to get away from the city and enjoy nature. Let me know if you need any birdwatching advice, I think I know a thing or two about bird watching. Or perhaps we can all go birdwatching soometimes.
[D20:16] Audrey: Thanks! That's so helpful, I'd love to take you up on your offer. Right now I'm going with this book that writes about bird watching guides.

Session date: 9:19 pm on 19 August, 2023
[D16:2] Audrey: Hi Andrew! The cafe sounds great, and the hike pic's great! August's been eventful - I learned a new skill! It was really awesome, making sure they were pampered and happy. I've always loved caring for my pups, and now taking care of their grooming myself makes me closer to them. They look so cute post-grooming!
[D16:3] Andrew: Wow that's awesome! You're doing an amazing job taking care of your pups. Can you show me a pic of them after the grooming? I bet they look adorable!
[D16:4] Audrey: Here's a photo of them after their grooming - look how soft and fluffy they are!
[D16:5] Andrew: Wow, they look so cute and fluffy! You did such a great job. How did you do it so well? I've always wanted to learn dog grooming but never got the time.
[D16:6] Audrey: I took a dog grooming course and learned lots of techniques. Would you like to hear some tips?
[D16:7] Andrew: Of course! I'd love to hear some tips. It's something I've always been interested in.
[...]
[D16:13] Andrew: This weekend I'm heading to a nature reserve to reconnect with the outdoors - excited!
[D16:14] Audrey: Cool! Have a great time reconnecting with nature. Don't forget to take some nice pictures!
[D16:15] Andrew: Sure thing, I'll get some awesome pics to show you when I return. 
[D16:16] Audrey: Haha thanks! Your pics of hikes are always nice.
[D16:17] Andrew: Yeah! I really wanted to save the moment ya know?
[D16:18] Audrey: No wonder. Now I can't wait for the pics. Take care and have fun! My dogs will be waiting too!
[D16:19] Andrew: Thanks! Can't wait to show you them when I'm back. See ya!

Session date: 5:41 pm on 3 May, 2023
[D4:1] Audrey: Hey Andrew! Long time no talk! Last week I finally went on a hike and had this amazing experience with a hummingbird. It was so cool watching it dart around with its wings! Nature is so beautiful.
[D4:2] Andrew: Hey Audrey! Glad to hear from you. That hummingbird was awesome! Nature's the best. Remember I was feeling down because I couldn't get out more? Well, good news - I found a new open space to hike nearby - feels so refreshing!
[D4:3] Audrey: That looks great! How often are you able to go hiking now?
[...]
[D4:11] Audrey: Absolutely. Not only the receiving end feels great, the person spreading it will feel great as well!
[D4:12] Andrew: Yeah, it's crazy how that can bring such great joy and calm to people.
[D4:13] Audrey: Yeah, by sharing something can make a big difference to others.
[...]
[D4:20] Andrew: Awesome to see that you take such good care of your dogs! What else do you do when you walk them?
[D4:21] Audrey: When I take them out, we usually play fetch with a ball or frisbee. They love chasing it! We also meet other dog owners in the park and have a doggie playdate. It's a great way for me to chat with people and for them to make new friends.
[D4:22] Andrew: Wow, looks like fun! They sure look excited about playing fetch!
